run_iodine_training: run the iodine model training loop with sacred experiment configuration and tensorboard summaries
build_component_from_config: build a dataset model or optimizer component from a sacred config identifier using utils.build
get_train_step_graph: get the tensorflow training step graph with gradient clipping and summary operations for a model
load_checkpoint_variables: load a trained iodine model checkpoint and print all global and local variable values
get_checkpoint_directory: get the checkpoint directory path for continuing an existing run or starting a new run
